ideas.title: Procedural levels
ideas.description: Build each level from hand-made room chunks stitched together by a seeded generator. Every run feels fresh, but the pieces stay hand-tuned so pacing never turns to mush.

ideas.title: Roguelike progression
ideas.description: Each run is short and lethal, but a small permanent unlock after every death keeps the player moving forward. Unlocks add options rather than raw power.

ideas.title: Daily seed challenge
ideas.description: Everyone plays the same seed once per day and compares scores on a tiny friends-only board. No servers beyond a single static score file.

ideas.title: Meta skill tree
ideas.description: A hub-side skill tree that spends currency earned across runs. Branches reshape playstyle, for example from stealth to brawler.

ideas.title: Drop-in co-op
ideas.description: A second player can join or leave at any time on the same level with no menus. Enemy count and rewards scale quietly with the party size.

ideas.title: Shared-screen puzzles
ideas.description: Puzzles that need two characters acting at once, such as one holds the door while the other crosses. Works on a single couch or online.

ideas.title: Cozy hub town
ideas.description: A calm home base where players decorate, meet friends and spend rewards between runs. Gives the studio's tougher games a gentle counterweight.

ideas.title: Chunky pixel-art style
ideas.description: A fixed low-resolution palette with strong silhouettes and limited animation frames. Keeps art production small enough for a two-person team.

ideas.title: Retro CRT shader
ideas.description: An optional screen filter with scanlines, slight curvature and colour bleed. Makes pixel art look at home on a modern monitor.

ideas.title: Sound-reactive visuals
ideas.description: Backgrounds, lighting and particles pulse with the music's amplitude and beat. Drives the look of boss fights and menus without hand-keyed animation.

ideas.title: Adaptive music
ideas.description: Layered stems fade in and out with danger and progress, so the soundtrack follows the action. One composer, one set of loops, many moods.

ideas.title: Dynamic narrator
ideas.description: A dry running commentary that reacts to deaths, near misses and streaks. Lines are short, tagged by situation and picked with a cooldown to avoid repeats.

ideas.title: Accessibility options
ideas.description: Remappable controls, colour-blind palettes, adjustable game speed and a switch to turn off screen effects. Planned from the start rather than bolted on.
